source: Sverige i fokus, chapter 7: Mänskliga rättigheter (extra draft)
questionSv: Vad händer när två grundläggande rättigheter kolliderar?
questionEn: What happens when two fundamental rights conflict?
options: Domstolar och myndigheter måste väga rättigheterna mot varandra i det enskilda fallet.
Den rättighet som tillkom senast upphäver alltid äldre rättigheter.
Yttrandefriheten väger alltid tyngre än alla andra rättigheter.
Konflikter mellan rättigheter avgörs genom en folkomröstning.
optionsEn: Courts and authorities must weigh the rights against each other in the individual case.
The right created most recently always cancels older rights.
Freedom of expression always outweighs all other rights.
Conflicts between rights are decided by referendum.
explanationEn: When rights conflict, courts and authorities weigh them against each other in the specific case; no right is automatically absolute, and conflicts are not decided by referendum.
